name: Azure Resource Manager
short_description: The deployment and management layer of Azure that accepts commands to create, update and delete resources and keeps track of what you own.

evidence.quote: You have to meet the service it extends and that service is Azure Resource Manager.
Bicep compiles to arm JSON, then Azure resource manager deploys it, same engine, same pipeline.
built by Microsoft, integrated with ARM, day zero support for new services.
it sits at the Azure resource manager layer, which is the actual control point for your entire environment
this is the belief that the Azure Resource Manager, or ARM, will be fully functional
In Azure, the control plane is Azure resource manager.
